incident-bot: AUTOMATED PAGE: p95->p99 latency burn on inference-prod (route: textual-gen). PagerDuty severity: P2. page_id=PD12345
maya: ack
maya: I'm on it, checking dashboards and recent deploys
jake: hit this early in the morning, looks like queue depth spiked in eu-west-1
maya: seeing same — p95 420ms -> p99 2.1s in last 5m. tokenizer queue backlog growing
maya: running `curl -s https://console/redwood/metrics?ts=now | jq '.p95'` — quick check showed spike aligns with 09:12 deploy window
sam: no deploys from infra at 09:12 in audit logs
maya: logs show a bunch of retries: `ERR: kvcache-miss; retry=1` — possible K/V eviction
priya: could be hotkeys? any hotkey spikes?

maya: mitigation plan: 1) enable regional fallback routing to us-west for new requests 2) bump dedicated pool size by +2 GPU nodes 3) enable kvcache-steady-warmup
maya: executing `redwood scale dedicated --pool inference-prod-eu --add 2` — ETA ~90s to nodes up
sam: enabling fallback: `redwood route update --from inference-prod-eu --to inference-prod-us --policy fallback` done :white_check_mark:
maya: warming kvcache, running prefetch for top 250 prefixes
jake: noticed a client started a big batch job ~09:10 — reaching out to acct team to ask for pause
priya: PagerDuty escalated to L2 after 5m — keeping L2 in loop
maya: p99 dropped from 2.1s -> 1.0s after routing kick-in, p95 -> 300ms — still above target, but improving
sam: GPUs scaling completed, pod count +2
maya: follow-up: schedule a quick rollback of the 09:12 deploy if we see re-regression in next 10m
jake: acct team confirmed they paused the batch job — thanked
maya: plan to hand off to priya for monitoring rotation in 30m
maya: @priya you're up for the 10:00-11:00 oncall window, I'll leave notes in incident doc
priya: ack. I'll keep watch and escalate if trends reverse. noted to file runbook tweak for hotkey mitigation
maya: closing pager (PD12345) to avoid duplicate noise, will reopen if re-fire :thumbsup:
